quarterly_data.signal: Inventec MOPS filing: the board approved on 06-30-2026, for Mexican subsidiary IEC Technologies, S. de R.L. de C.V., additional construction funds of US$7,170 ten-thousand for the Ciudad Juarez plant site, raising the total construction budget to not more than US$111.7 million (the 03-10-2026 board approval had set it at not more than US$40 million); stated purpose: building production and warehouse plant buildings for future order demand.
quarterly_data.figure: additional US$7,170 ten-thousand; total budget not exceeding US$111.7 million (previously US$40 million)
